summary.headline: Sunteck FY26 presales rose 25% to INR3,157 crore and FY26 PAT grew 34% to INR202 crore; management guides similar growth for FY27.
summary.overview: Q4 FY26 presales were INR1,064 crore (up 22%) and Q4 collections were INR432 crore (up 39%). Q4 operating revenue was INR339 crore with EBITDA of INR97 crore (29% margin) and PAT of INR63 crore (19% margin). For FY26, revenue was INR1,124 crore (up 32%), EBITDA INR305 crore (27% margin, up 64%) and PAT INR202 crore (18% margin, up 34%). Business development spend rose to over INR800 crore from under INR200 crore in FY25, adding three projects with about INR50bn GDV, and net debt/equity stayed at 0.06x.

segments.name: Uber luxury and premium luxury
segments.commentary: Management says these segments drive a growing share of presales; uber luxury and other commercial were about 50% of current sales (about INR600 crore), premium luxury 40-45% (INR360-370 crore in Q4). Q4 uber luxury (BKC and Nepean Sea Road) sales were INR609 crore, about INR1,500 crore in 12 months.

segments.name: Aspirational luxury
segments.commentary: Contributed about 10-15% of current sales (INR94-100 crore); management sees early demand recovery on lower home loan rates and tax benefits.

segments.name: Redevelopment and new acquisitions
segments.commentary: Three projects added in FY26 with about INR50bn combined GDV: Andheri Western Express Highway redevelopment (1-2.5 acres), Mira Road joint development (3.5 acres), and outright Andheri airport-side 1.75 acre land. Total GDV stands at about INR441bn gross of presales.

guidance_outlook: FY27 presales growth guided at a similar rate to FY26 (about 25%), with management 'very confident' even excluding Dubai.
Recently signed projects expected at 30-35% EBITDA margin; blended margin about 35-40%; minimum 30-35% per project for any new acquisition, redevelopment or JV/JD.
FY27 collections to improve as a share of sales; management expects strong cash flow in FY27 and FY28.

Approximately INR6,000-7,000 crore GDV of launches planned over the next 12 months, including Andheri redevelopment, Sunteck Sky Park Mira Road tower, two towers at Sunteck Beach Residences Vasai, new phase at Sunteck World Naigaon, Mira Road acquisition, and Nepean Sea Road.
Revenue recognition expected from Sunteck One World Naigaon delivery in FY27 plus ready inventory.
Business development spend in FY27 to be higher, subject to maintaining high IRR and equity multiple.
risks_watch: Dubai launch timing is uncertain due to the Middle East conflict; no firm date given.
Footfalls fell 5-10% in the month before the call; management says conversions are steady, so Q1 FY27 presales are worth tracking.
Collections (INR1,433 crore, up 14%) lag presales growth (25%); monitor the FY27 collection-to-sales ratio.
BD spend of over INR800 crore in FY26 raises execution and balance-sheet risk; watch the net debt/equity level.
Imported finished-goods cost pressure and labour availability could affect costs and timelines.
Nepean Sea Road RERA approval and Andheri JB Nagar use decision (residential vs commercial) are pending.
summary.management_tone: Confident and bullish on uber luxury, premium luxury and FY27 growth, though answers on Dubai timing and the Middle East impact were evasive and gave no firm dates. Management was candid that footfalls fell 5-10% over the last month.
key_quotes: So we are very, very optimistic about the BD investments as well.
There is absolutely no shortage in terms of cement or steel or RMC or the stand or a break or those kind of things.
We are very, very confident about our growth of the whatever we have done in the current year, similar growth of 25% in the coming year as well.

INR8.1 billion (over INR800 crore per Q&A)

qa_highlights.question: Update on Dubai launch timeline given the Middle East conflict, and whether demand excitement persists.
qa_highlights.answer: Project is launch-ready and will launch ASAP once the situation settles; no exact timeline given. Management says there is no debt at company or Dubai SPV level and that profitability holds even if the market corrects 10-20%.

qa_highlights.question: Will FY27 business development spend exceed INR800 crore or grow 20-25%?
qa_highlights.answer: FY25 BD was under INR200 crore and FY26 over INR800 crore. FY27 investment will be aggressive, funded by strong cash flow, but subject to maintaining IRR and equity multiple; management is very optimistic on BD.

qa_highlights.question: Will collections improve substantially in FY27 given collections grew 14% vs 25% sales growth?
qa_highlights.answer: Management agreed that collections as a share of sales must improve in FY27, with strong cash flow expected in FY27 and FY28.

qa_highlights.question: What launches are expected in the next 12 months apart from Dubai, and what is the GDV?
qa_highlights.answer: Launches include Andheri redevelopment, Sunteck Sky Park Mira Road tower, two towers at Sunteck Beach Residences Vasai, new Sunteck World Naigaon phase, Mira Road acquisition and Nepean Sea Road; total GDV close to INR6,000-7,000 crore.

qa_highlights.question: What margins to expect from recent acquisitions and the blended margin on FY26 presales?
qa_highlights.answer: Recently signed projects are expected at 30-35% EBITDA margin, with blended margin around 35-40%; minimum 30-35% per project for new acquisitions, redevelopments or JV/JDs.

qa_highlights.question: Will pre-sales growth of similar magnitude be achieved even excluding Dubai, and will Q1 be soft given footfall declines?
qa_highlights.answer: Management is 100% confident of similar growth irrespective of Dubai. It said the footfall drop was about one month, attributed to a peak in the event, and that Q4 uber luxury and premium luxury sales were strong.
